sourceReference: DRAFT profile, sources read 2026-10-04, from LCRA's On-Site Sewage FAQs, LCRA's maintenance contract and inspection report cover sheet, LCRA's OSSF jurisdiction map, LCRA's OSSF order (effective 2010-04-05) and TCEQ's OSSF maintenance page. See profile.sources and docs/jurisdictions/tx-lcra-ossf.md.

requirementEffective.basis: LCRA's OSSF order and fee schedule, adopted 2010-01-20, effective 2010-04-05 (the current order; earlier LCRA OSSF rules existed). The TCEQ rules it enforces (30 TAC Chapter 285) are amended from time to time; the reporting text read here is from the 2022 adoption (47 TexReg 8898).

sources.title: LCRA On-Site Sewage FAQs (maintenance contracts and reports)
sources.note: Complete the maintenance contract and inspection report cover sheet and email it with your contract or report to ossf@lcra.org. No last-updated date shown.

sources.title: LCRA OSSF Program Maintenance Contract & Inspection Report Cover Sheet
sources.note: LCRA's fillable PDF (one page, ten text fields; PDF modified 2019-01-29). Fields: Date, Maintenance Provider Name, TCEQ MP # (REQUIRED), LCRA OSSF Application Number (REQUIRED), Property Owners Name, Property Address, Contract Term Start/End, Number of Inspections a Year, Inspection Report Date. Email to: OSSF@LCRA.ORG.

sources.title: LCRA water quality jurisdictions map (OSSF)
sources.note: The red area is where LCRA regulates septic systems. Look up by address or ZIP; unclear cases: 512-578-3200 or 800-776-5272.

sources.title: LCRA OSSF order and fee schedule
sources.note: Adopted 2010-01-20, effective 2010-04-05. Covers the Highland Lakes restricted and water quality zones (Buchanan, Inks, LBJ, Marble Falls, Travis).

sources.title: TCEQ OSSF maintenance requirements
sources.note: Last modified 2026-03-03. Report to the permitting authority and owner at least every four months (six with electronic monitoring and automatic notification), within 14 days after the test, including all responses to owner complaints and electronic monitoring notices.

sources.title: TCEQ rule adoption, 30 TAC Chapter 285 (Project 2021-030-285-CE)
sources.note: Published 47 TexReg 8898 (2022-12-30). §285.7(d)(2): contract to the permitting authority 30 days before the initial two-year policy expires; later contracts at least 30 days before the contract expires. §285.7: the report includes any responses to owner complaints and goes to the permitting authority and owner within 14 days of the test. Read through a summarizer.

sources.title: Fort Bend County: annual maintenance contract renewal
sources.note: Quotes TAC 285.7(d)(2), including 'at least 30 days before the contract expires'. Fort Bend is not an authority in Aerowise; used only as a second reading of the rule.

unresolved: LCRA has not confirmed that it accepts its cover sheet filled in electronically and attached to an email (the FAQ asks to 'complete' it). Aerowise fills LCRA's own fillable PDF; confirm acceptance with LCRA before the pilot.
LCRA publishes no acknowledgment or confirmation process for emailed contracts and reports.
LCRA does not publish the format of the LCRA OSSF application number, so it cannot be checked beyond being present.
The counties listed only trigger review (they hold the lakes named in LCRA's order); LCRA's map, not the county, decides each site.

The 30-day contract timing was read from TCEQ's 2022 adoption of 30 TAC 285.7 through a page summarizer, not the official Texas Administrative Code text; confirm against the current rule before relying on the deadline in enforcement.

The six-month inspection schedule for systems with electronic monitoring is not available: Aerowise does not record whether a system has qualifying monitoring and automatic notification, so every site is held to four months.

applicability.howToDecide: Look the address up on LCRA's OSSF jurisdiction map (https://waterquality.lcra.org/ossf/; the red area is LCRA's OSSF jurisdiction). If it is unclear, call LCRA at 512-578-3200 or 800-776-5272 for a determination. Record what you checked.

identifiers.label: LCRA OSSF Application Number
identifiers.help: Marked REQUIRED on LCRA's cover sheet. Find it on the LCRA permit or license to operate.

contracts.note: LCRA asks for contracts by email with the cover sheet. Timing from 30 TAC 285.7(d)(2) (text read in TCEQ's 2022 adoption, 47 TexReg 8898; also quoted by Fort Bend County): the signed contract goes to the permitting authority 30 days before the initial two-year service policy expires, and each later contract at least 30 days before the current one expires. Not required when a single-family owner maintains the system personally (285.7(d)(4)); not for commercial, speculative residential or multifamily property.
